discoveries: Jetstreamer supports bounded historical slot ranges from Old Faithful CAR archives; its README says Anza no longer maintains it and points to Vaultic as the continuation.

Yellowstone Faithful v0.7.30 exposes getBlock/getTransaction RPC over remote CAR and indexes but labels the archive tooling RFC/not production-ready. Epoch 1056 uses a 662,973,441,613-byte CAR and a 5,184,000-byte 12-byte-per-slot range index; getBlocks returned null in the tested release while getBlock worked. The current Jetstreamer README also says Old Faithful lacks account updates and describes its transactions as already-executed ledger data, not transaction execution.

For slot 456558897, Old Faithful and Solana Vibe Station independently agreed on block hash, previous hash, parent slot and all 457 ordered signatures; verified SYLPH staging decoded 9 Pump invocations into 10 events without touching the production database or feed latch.
patterns: use per-slot range indexes and HTTP range reads instead of downloading a whole epoch CAR
cross-check archive block hash, parent linkage and ordered transaction signatures against a separate finalized RPC
keep historical replay evidence, staging projection, live health and capital authority as separate state machines
handle unsupported range APIs explicitly; never interpret a null getBlocks result as an empty/skipped range
Keep archive replay as block/transaction history; do not infer account-state completeness or live freshness from replayed transaction records.
sources.overlap: SYLPH already has bounded finalized-range audits, independent header comparison, hashed evidence manifests, a gap reconciler and a separate staging database. The verified archive RPC is now an optional staging recovery source; it is not a replacement for Yellowstone live ingestion or production RPC authority.
